info.title: SSS Reporting API
info.description: API contracts for the SSS project, focusing on report generation.

get.summary: Generate and Export a Leave Report
get.description: Generates a comprehensive leave report based on the specified type and exports it in the chosen format. The response will be a file download. Conditional parameters are required based on the report type.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of report to generate.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The file format for the exported report.

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: The UUID of the employee. Required if report type is 'EMPLOYEE_LEAVE'.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: The UUID of the department. Required if report type is 'DEPARTMENT_LEAVE'.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month for the report (1-12). Required if report type is 'MONTHLY_LEAVE'.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The year for the report (e.g., 2023). Required if report type is 'MONTHLY_LEAVE'.

200.description: Report generated successfully. The response body contains the file content, and the 'Content-Disposition' header suggests a filename.

400.description: Bad Request. Invalid or missing parameters.

403.description: Forbidden. User does not have administrative privileges to generate reports.

500.description: Internal Server Error. An error occurred while generating the report.

ReportType.description: Defines the types of reports that can be generated.

ExportFormat.description: Defines the available export formats for the reports.

details.description: Additional details about the error, often used for validation.

example.type: must be one of [DEPARTMENT_LEAVE, MONTHLY_LEAVE, EMPLOYEE_LEAVE]
